items.rationale: The key BT-330 is in row 5 and column J holds the cost, 2,600, on that row.
XLOOKUP needs the lookup range and the return range to be the same size. Here one has 5 cells and the other 4, so the formula gives #VALUE! even though the code exists.
Supplier is column K. Column J is the cost and column I is the retail price. The range $G$2:$K$6 covers five columns, so it is not a single column and cannot be the return range.
SL-075 sells at 499 and costs 220, so the profit per pair is 499 - 220 = 279 KES.
